verdict: Paid channels are dark; organic profile activity is the sole signal this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no spend ran on Meta or Google Ads, so there are no paid leads to report and no cost-per-lead to compute. All 147 profile actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks — came entirely from organic Google Business Profile traffic. That organic activity itself deteriorated sharply in the most recent week, dropping 78% compared to the prior 7-day period, with zero actions recorded on six of the last seven days. We are working to get paid campaigns back live and to diagnose the GBP activity drop so there is an active baseline to build from next period.

watch_item.issue: One of your three Google Business profiles generated 386 impressions over 25 days but recorded zero calls — a call rate of 0% against roughly 0.9% on comparable profiles, pointing to a likely call button or tracking issue.
watch_item.fix: We are auditing that profile's call setup now and will confirm or restore proper tracking this week.
